Bathroom & Sanitaryware category page

URL https://www.buildingworld.ai/products/categories/bathroom-and-sanitaryware Audited 14 Oct 2026 · Desktop 1324 px Stack: Next.js App Router (React Server Components)

Method: the raw server HTML (what a crawler receives before JavaScript runs) was fetched and compared, element by element, with the fully rendered page. Text present in the server HTML is SSR. Text that only appears after JavaScript runs is CSR.

Findings

FindingEvidenceFix
CRITICALServer HTML is 2.74 MB, above Googlebot's 2 MB fetch limitOne inline RSC script is 1.97 MB. It serialises 245 product records (initialData.items) while only 13 products are rendered. Visible content ends at ~0.77 MB so it survives, but the hydration payload is cut off, which can break rendering for Google.Send only fields the card needs, and only for the products on this page. Move the rest to a client fetch or the product page.
CRITICALPagination is not crawlable"Previous, 1–6, …, 781, Next" are <button> elements with no href. No rel="next". 15,604 products across 781 pages, but crawlers can reach only the first 20.Render pagination as <a href="?page=2"> links, with each page SSR and self-canonical.
CRITICALSubcategory navigation is CSR and has no linksSidebar category tree (33 items), the subcategory chip carousel (123 chips) and Related Category (22 items) are missing from server HTML and are not <a href> elements.Server-render these lists as plain links to each subcategory URL. This is the main internal-link path to category pages.
CRITICAL7 of 20 product cards are CSR onlyThe 7 cards after the "Shop By Brands" strip (Ozone, Toto, Jaquar, Ruhe, Mirrorwala…) have title, brand and price only in the browser.Render every card in the first page on the server.
CRITICALFooter is entirely CSRServer HTML has no <footer>. "Explore & Discover", "Quick Links", "Connect With Us", About Us, Terms of Use, Privacy Policy and Contact Us are client-only.Make the footer a server component. Its links carry site-wide trust and link equity.
CRITICALNo structured data in server HTML0 JSON-LD blocks in server HTML. Only a WebSite block is injected by JavaScript. No BreadcrumbList, ItemList/CollectionPage or Organization.Server-render BreadcrumbList + ItemList (product URLs) + Organization JSON-LD.
CRITICAL"Shop By Brands" strip is CSRH2 and 16 brand names (Jaquar, Duravit, Kohler, Toto…) render only in the browser and are not links in the server HTML.Server-render the strip with links to brand/category filter pages.
ISSUEH1 is visually hidden<h1 class="sr-only">Bathroom and sanitaryware</h1>. The visible title "Bathroom and Sanitaryware" is a <p class="truncate">.Make the visible title the H1 and remove the hidden one.
ISSUEH2 text changes after hydrationServer: "Explore 15604 Bathroom and sanitaryware Products Online". Browser: "…Sanitaryware…".Format the string the same way on server and client.
ISSUEWeak heading outlineServer HTML has 1 H2. H3s are only filter labels (Category, Brand, Price, Color, Rating, Related Category). Product names are <p>.Use H2 for sections and H3 (or a link inside a heading) for product names.
ISSUEProduct title text is outside the card linkThe card's <a> wraps the image; the title <p> is not inside it, so anchor text comes from image alt only.Wrap the product name in the product link.
ISSUEMeta description is 175 charactersGoogle usually truncates near 155–160. Also inconsistent Title Case.Trim to about 150 characters, sentence case.
ISSUEHeavy DOM4,979 elements after render. 221 images in the DOM versus 67 in server HTML.Virtualise carousels, render chips and brand logos lazily below the fold.
ISSUECard labels are CSR"Delivered to:" / "Dealers at:" labels and the "Onwards" price suffix appear only in the browser. Minor for ranking, but they cause text shifts.Render with the card on the server.

PriorityActionImpact
1Shrink the RSC payload under 2 MB (send only the 20 cards' fields)Keeps the whole page within Googlebot's fetch limit, faster HTML
2Pagination as <a href> linksOpens 781 pages / 15,604 products to crawling
3SSR category tree, chips and related categories as linksInternal linking to every subcategory
4SSR all 20 product cards, the brand strip and the footerAll visible content indexable without JS
5Add BreadcrumbList, ItemList, Organization JSON-LD on the serverRich results eligibility

Googlebot fetch limit source: Google Search Central blog, “Inside Googlebot: demystifying crawling, fetching, and the bytes we process” (March 2026). Core Web Vitals were not measured: this tab reached the page through in-app navigation, so the browser's load metrics belong to the homepage.
